From the Pittsburgh Pennies to hosting the best modern-day talent in the PWHL, the Penguins organization is proud to honor and celebrate the women who make a difference in the sport of hockey.  
We are proud to share some of the initiatives happening during March 2025, Women's History Month.

# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/community/womens-history
## Her Hockey Day presented by 84 Lumber

## Her Hockey Day presented by 84 Lumber  
On Sunday, March 2, the Pittsburgh Penguins and Penguins Foundation will host the 7th Annual Her Hockey Day presented by 84 Lumber.
Her Hockey Day aims to recognize the incredible passion of our women fans during the NHLâs Celebrating Womenâs History Month. From girls stepping onto the ice for the first time to women supporting the Penguins from home to those who are trailblazers for our great game, we will celebrate YOU on March 2.  
Further, thanks to 84 Lumber, local women will be recognized for their community engagement and empowered to continue to make Pittsburgh a city of equality. Join us for Her Hockey Day on March 2 at PPG Paints Arena or by visiting the Penguins on social media and by watching the Penguins vs. Leafs game at 1PM.  
As part of the celebration, informational tables will be in the DICKâS Sporting Goods Hall of Champions featuring organizations tied to advocating for female empowerment in Western Pennsylvania.

## L.I.F.T. EmpowerHER Grant

## L.I.F.T. EmpowerHER Grant  
More than 200 EmpowerHER Grant nominations were collected and three finalists have been determined: Autumnâs Bridal & Prom, Gloria Horn Sewing Studio, and UrbanÓ Boutique.  
Congratulations to the 2025 EmpowerHER Grant Winner - Gloria Horn Sewing Studio!  
84 Lumber is a proud nationally certified woman-owned and -operated business through the Womenâs Business Enterprise National Council (WBENC). The EmpowerHER Grant is a part of 84 Lumberâs L.I.F.T. (Leading & Inspiring Females to Thrive) program with the Pittsburgh Penguins.

# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/community/womens-history
## Her Hockey Auction

## Her Hockey Auction  
Join the Pittsburgh Penguins Foundation for the Her Hockey Auction as the NHL together celebrates women's history.  
Her Hockey locker room nameplates, Penguins autographed memorabilia, female featured art and more to the Pittsburgh Pennies, a girls' ice hockey program established to increase the number of girls who play hockey and to promote gender equality in the sport.  
Starting on Sunday, March 2, fans will have until March 10 at 12 PM (noon) to bid to assist with growing girls hockey in our region. Text HERHOCKEY to 76278 or visit herhockey.givesmart.com

## L.I.F.T. (Leading & Inspiring Females to Thrive) Women's Panel and Networking Event

## L.I.F.T. (Leading & Inspiring Females to Thrive) Women's Panel and Networking Event  
Hear from a panel of accomplished women professionals throughout several industries that have previously been deemed as âmale dominant.â Hear their stories of how they overcame any obstacles they faced along their paths to success and leadership and the importance of their own female advocacy networks along the way. The discussion will also focus on how theyâve taken traits of a successful âteamâ and instituted these elements along with an emphasis on goal-setting and accountability throughout their companies. For additional details and to reserve your spot, please contact Bernadette Provost at [email protected].
